study_type_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic studies of dTBP2 and PEG-dTBP2 were conducted in ICR male mice with 3 animals in each group at a dose of 10 mg/kg.
The test peptides (final concentration: 1 μM) with human or mouse liver microsomes (final concentration: 0.5 mg/ml) in 100 mM potassium phosphate buffer

in_vitro_detail: Metabolic stability of dTBP2 and PEG-dTBP2 (1 μM) in human or mouse liver microsomes (0.5 mg/ml) in 100 mM potassium phosphate buffer pH 7.4 with an NADPH regenerating system for 30 min at 37 degrees C, quantified by LC-MS/MS with buspirone hydrochloride as internal standard - a subcellular enzyme preparation, classified as in vitro per the protocol's 'purified enzyme, cell-free system' rule. Also BEAS-2B human bronchial epithelial cell culture for dTCTP-induced IL-8 secretion and MTT cell viability.

notes: PK parameters come from Table 1 after a single 10 mg/kg intravenous dose in male ICR mice, n = 3 per group, calculated by non-compartmental analysis in Phoenix WinNonlin 6.4. UNIT CAVEAT: in the rendered Table 1 the T1/2 row carries no unit, whereas AUC (μg·hr/ml), CL (L/kg/hr) and Vss (L/kg) rows do; the value has been recorded exactly as printed with the missing unit flagged rather than assuming hours. The parameter is unambiguously a half-life, not a rate constant - the table footnote states 'T1/2 terminal half-life' and the Results text says 'Terminal T1/2 and AUC of PEG-dTBP2 increased by about 2.54-fold and 116-fold more than dTBP2' (2.57/1.01 = 2.54, consistent). half_life_phase is therefore 'terminal/beta'. Because the analysis was non-compartmental with a single terminal T1/2 and no two-phase fit, half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are both left 'not reported'. Dosing was intravenous, so no absorption phase exists. Cmax and tmax are not reported. Clearance and volume of distribution are also tabulated (dTBP2 CL 409.01 ± 98.89 and Vss 487.21 ± 168.28; PEG-dTBP2 CL 3.06 ± 0.57 and Vss 6.35 ± 2.57). Separate in vitro microsomal stability values are reported (30% of dTBP2 versus 75% of PEG-dTBP2 remaining after 30 min with human liver microsomes; 2.5- and 5-fold better stability in human and mouse microsomes respectively) but these are not half-lives and are not placed in any half_life field. The body contains an apparent typographical slip in the IL-8 results - 'the same concentrations of native PEG-dTBP2 reduced the level of IL-8 to 30% and 40%' appears to mean native dTBP2. Role 'other' is used for OVA/alum and recombinant dTCTP because they are disease-model induction and cell-stimulation agents rather than test articles; the protocol role enum does not cover these.
